scripts.example:sqlite: vp run -r build && mkdir -p .data && DB=sqlite SQLITE_FILE=.data/example.sqlite node --env-file-if-exists=.env examples/basic/src/server.ts
scripts.example:postgres: vp run db:up && vp run -r build && DB=postgres node --env-file-if-exists=.env examples/basic/src/server.ts
scripts.example:mysql: vp run db:up && vp run -r build && DB=mysql node --env-file-if-exists=.env examples/basic/src/server.ts
scripts.release: vp run -r build && bash scripts/check-pack.sh && pnpm -r publish --access public
